ORDER FOR POSTING AND MAILING OF SUMMONS
DEMAND FOR JURY FILED BY DEFENDANT FUAAU, OLA AS TO PLAINTIFF PARKER, DAVID
ANSWER FILED BY DEFENDANT FUAAU, OLA
MEMO TO SET FOR JURY TRIAL FILED BY PLAINTIFF PARKER, DAVID SET FOR JURY TRIAL ON APR-01-2003 AT 09:00 AM IN DEPT 206 NOTICE OF TIME AND PLACE OF TRIAL FILED
NOTICE OF SETTLEMENT HEARING SETTLEMENT CONFERENCE SET FOR MAR-27-2003 AT 02:00 PM IN DEPT 218
MINUTES FOR MAR-27-2003 2:00 PM FOR DEPT 218
MASTER JURY CALENDAR SET FOR APR-01-2003 VACATED. SETTLEMENT CONFERENCE HELD. MATTER SETTLED. JUDGE PRO TEM N. ROSENQUEST, CLERK J. BAUBEL, REPORTER K. FARNSWORTH (501A)

REMOVED FROM SETTLEMENT CONFERENCE CALENDAR ON MAR-27-2003 IN DEPT. 218 - MATTER SETTLED. PLAINTIFF TO RECOVER RESTITUTION OF THE PREMISES KNOWN AS 24 LEONA TERRACE. PLAINTIFF WAIVES RENTS AND UNLAWFUL DETAINER DAMAGES, EACH SIDE BEARS ITS OWN COSTS. THERE IS A MUTUAL RELEASE OF CLAIMS. THERE IS A STAY OF EXECUTION UNTIL 11:59 PM, 5-31-03 WITRH NO FURTHER STAYS. DEFENDANT WARRANTS NO OTHER ADULTS ARE IN POSESSION OF THE PREMISES. PLAINTIFF IS TO BE RETURNED HER SECURITY DEPOSIT OF $995 AND $150 INTEREST IN 2 INSTALLMENTS, $650 AT THE TIME JUDGMENT IS PREPARED, 4-4-03, $495 AT THE TIME DEFENDANT SURRENDERS POSESSION OF THE PREMISES, 6-2-03; PLAINTIFF VERIFIES NO ONE ELSE IS IN POSESSION OF THE PREMISES PLAINTIFF WILL SET ASIDE AND DISMISS THE JUDGMENT IF DEFENDANT TIMELY VACATES THE PREMISES. COUNSEL TO PREPARE AND SUBMIT JUDGMENT AS ORDERED BY THE COURT. JPT N. ROSENQUEST, CLERK J. BAUBEL, RPTR K. FARNSWORTH (501A)
SUBSTITUTION OF ATTORNEY: MARQUEZ, JAK STEVEN SUBSTITUTED FOR MACDONALD, STEVEN ADAIR AS ATTORNEY FOR PARKER, DAVID
DISMISSAL OF ENTIRE ACTION OF ALL PARTIES AND ALL CAUSES OF ACTION WITH PREJUDICE

THE COURT ORDERED THE FOLLOWING STIPULATED JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF PARKER, DAVID RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT FUAAU, OLA THE RESTITUTION AND POSSESSION OF THE PREMISES: 24 LEONA TERRACE, STAYED UNTIL MAY-31-2003, LEASE FORFEITED, FOR DETAILS SEE SCANNED DOC
